title: Sales by Country
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Largest market
kpis.sql: SELECT g.country FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Largest average order
kpis.sql: SELECT g.country FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Fastest growing country
kpis.sql: SELECT g.country FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 1 END) >= 150 ORDER BY sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Its growth %
kpis.sql: SELECT max(gr) FROM (SELECT 100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) - 1) AS gr FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY g.country HAVING count(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 1 END) >= 150)

kpis.sql: SELECT g.country FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND g.country IN ('Poland', 'Germany') GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 1 END) >= 150 ORDER BY sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Its growth %
kpis.sql: SELECT max(gr) FROM (SELECT 100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) - 1) AS gr FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND g.country IN ('Poland', 'Germany') GROUP BY g.country HAVING count(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 1 END) >= 150)

density.rule: a growth % per row needs 150 in the current period; smaller countries fold into 'Other countries', which is why the fold is measured, not the raw smallest country
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) >= 150 THEN g.country ELSE 'Other countries' END AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY g.country)
